description: This Java file defines the 'ExpiringTimerBuilder' class, which implements a builder pattern for creating 'StartedTimer' instances that automatically expire after a specified maximum duration. It manages timer creation, tagging, expiration handling, and cancellation logic using scheduled executor services.

classes.name: ExpiringTimerBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating timers that automatically expire after a maximum duration, with optional expiration handling.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Adds multiple tags to the timer, overwriting existing tags with the same keys.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Adds a single tag to the timer, overwriting existing tags with the same key.

methods.name: expirationHandling
methods.description: Sets custom handling logic to be executed when the timer expires.

methods.name: maximumDuration
methods.description: Sets the maximum duration the timer should run before automatic expiration.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and starts the timer, scheduling expiration handling after the specified maximum duration.

methods.name: cancelScheduledExpirationFuture
methods.description: Cancels the scheduled expiration task if the timer stops before timeout.

methods.name: defaultExpirationHandling
methods.description: Default method invoked upon timer expiration; executes additional handling and stops the timer.
